A dish that combines the thick sweetness of honey with the acidity of sour fruits.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Honeyed Fruits are dishes made by [[Cooking]] [[Courser Bee Honey]] with any [[Fruit]], aside from [[Apple]]s, in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The regular version can be made by using Fruits with an effect that counteracts that of the Courser Bee Honey. When eaten, they will restore some [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. This [[Meal]] combines the sweetness of Courser Bee Honey with the sourness of Fruits. Only one variation of Honeyed Fruits can be made: * '''Energizing Honeyed Fruits''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Honeyed Fruits}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A dish that combines the thick sweetness of honey with the acidity of sour fruits.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using neutral Fruits, such as [[Palm Fruit]]s or [[Wildberry|Wildberries]]. Eating them will refill a part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Honeyed Fruits boost the amount of [[Rupee]]s the [[Warrior]] gains by 30% when prepared before a [[Scenario]] or [[Challenge]]. They are made using two [[Hearty Durian]]s, two [[Hydromelon]]s, two [[Voltfruit]]s, and two Courser Bee Honeys. However, it can be lowered to one of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". The recipe can be earned by completing the Quest "[[Bee Very Careful]]". {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Honeyed Fruits Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Honeyed Fruits ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Honeyed Apple * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
